parameters.formDescription: Please upload your current Open Invoices export and your recent Bank Statement below. The system will automatically cross-reference payment references and amounts to generate your matching report. (Supported formats: .xlsx)

parameters.content:
# 💰 Payment Reconciliation
### Match bank deposits to open invoices automatically

## What this does
Upload your **Open Invoices** export and your latest **Bank Statement**, and this workflow cross-references them for you. Every payment is sorted into exact matches, partial (short or over) payments, unpaid invoices, and deposits with no matching invoice, then shown as a clean report you can download as a PDF.

## How it works
1. The user uploads two *.xlsx* files through the intake form.
2. Both spreadsheets are read into rows.
3. A code step matches bank credits to invoices by invoice number and amount.
4. The results are grouped into four buckets and rendered as an HTML summary.
5. The report is shown on screen with a download / print button.

## Set up steps
Takes about 5 minutes.

**1. Match your column names**
Open the **Match & Build Report** node. The matching relies on these exact headers: invoices need *Invoice ID* and *Total Amount Due*; the bank file needs *Credit*, *Debit*, *Value Date*, and *Reference / Description*. Rename the columns in your exports, or adjust the names in the code to fit your own.

**2. Check the reference format**
A payment matches when a bank reference contains the full invoice ID, or its last three digits (for example *201* from *INV-2024-201*). If your invoice numbers follow a different pattern, tweak the matching rule in the code.

**3. Activate and share the form**
Set the workflow to active, open the form URL, and upload the two files to generate a report.

## 📥 Upload Intake Form
Collects two spreadsheet uploads from the user, the **Open Invoices** export and the **Bank Statement**, both as *.xlsx* files. The form holds the browser open until the run finishes so the summary report can be shown on screen.

## 📄 Read Invoices File
Reads the uploaded **Open Invoices** spreadsheet and turns every row into a data item. Each invoice needs an *Invoice ID* and a *Total Amount Due* column for the matching step to work.

## 🏦 Read Bank Statement
Reads the uploaded **Bank Statement** spreadsheet into data items, one per transaction. It expects *Credit*, *Debit*, *Value Date*, and *Reference / Description* columns.

## 🔗 Merge Streams
Waits for both files to finish reading, then brings the two branches back together so the next step runs once. The matching code pulls each dataset by node name, so this node mainly keeps the flow in sync.

## 🧮 Match & Build Report
Compares every bank credit against the open invoices by invoice number and amount, sorting them into exact matches, partial matches, unpaid invoices, and unmatched deposits. It then builds the full HTML summary page the user sees at the end.

## 🖥️ Show Summary
Displays the finished reconciliation report in the browser as a styled dashboard with a print / download-PDF button. This is the last step, so the user lands here the moment the run completes.
